name: Aiven
line: Managed databases, caches, search, streams, and container apps.

free.text: 1 GB disk; may power off idle, deleted after 180 days off

sql.math: 730 hours a month at $0.016 an hour. Whether the storage and connection limits fit your app is not guaranteed.
An idle database still bills for all 730 hours a month. Costs for files stored outside it are not included.

files.math: Aiven has no file storage plan of its own.

jobs.math: 5 apps × 730 hours a month × $0.03836 an hour. This is an example for the workers only, before queue and other outside costs.
